name: 97232 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97232 (Portland) has 209 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97232 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97232 (Portland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).
